{{Quote|I came aboard the ''Visara'', a transport escort. I was told we were the closest ship.|Degoren|<ref name="RE" />}}
The '''''Visara''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] which served as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] escort in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Degoren]] was tasked with capturing [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], one of the leaders of the Alliance. In an attempt to lure Organa into a trap, Degoren took the crew of the Alliance ship ''[[Gamble]]''&mdash;on which Organa had been traveling&mdash;hostage on the commercial [[Space station/Legends|space platform]] [[Arnot Station]] while the Princess was away from the ship. When Organa tried to contact the ''Gamble'', Degoren answered and claimed to be a commander from the ''Visara''. Though Organa had seen the ''Visara''{{'s}} name on a list of the Alliance's transport escort ships, she knew nothing else of the ship and, after further questioning Degoren, recognized his deception.<ref name="RE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Visara'' was first mentioned in the [[2013]] novel ''[[Razor's Edge]]'', which was written by [[Martha Wells]].<ref name="RE" />
